statement: Reconcile the six Generation-1 research obligations, classify equivalent/dominated/blocked routes, select the next load-bearing FULL178 frontier, and create only the necessary next DAG nodes.

scope.quantifiers: all six initial obligations must be resolved before reconciliation starts
scope.required_output: deduplicated route ledger, selected next frontier, dependency update, and new dispatch only if justified

notes: Do not open this node early.
Do not treat completion of Generation-1 research as FULL178 census completion.
